summary: Master HR metrics and analytics with our comprehensive training course. Gain insights to drive strategic decisions and optimize workforce management effectively
lede: HR analytics helps HR professionals turn workforce data into consistent measures and evidence for workforce decisions. For HR teams and people analytics specialists, the course provides practical ways to define metrics, check data quality, and interpret employee trends. Learners practice analyzing turnover, absence, recruitment, and learning measures, then use dashboards and an HR scorecard to communicate findings while considering data limits and responsible use.
audienceIntro: Human Resource Metrics and Analytics Training suits professionals who prepare, interpret, govern, or use workforce data in operational and strategic decisions. It is appropriate for foundation to intermediate learners who need practical HR measurement capability rather than advanced statistical programming.
modules: HR Data Quality and Measurement Design
Talent Acquisition Metrics and Funnel Analysis
Digital HR Analytics and Responsible Automation
Executive Reporting and HR Analytics Action Plans
prerequisites: No programming experience is required. You should have basic familiarity with HR processes, employee data, spreadsheets, or management reporting. You will work with supplied, anonymized datasets and may use Excel, Power BI, or Tableau during practical exercises.
